productIntent: A compact, replayable web Arcade sampler that feels complete without reproducing the full mobile game.

donor.note: Use the existing Arcade runtime and sealed web cartridge. Do not publish the entire standalone/player release package.

qualification.purpose: Prove the cartridge, Standard Arcade gameplay depth, isolation, controls, host bridge, persistence boundary, and package integrity before website integration.
qualification.note: The current Toadal-only work is a qualification stage. A 16-second/level-1 witness is insufficient for Stage A closure.

standard.calibrationRule: Measure real Standard runs first. Add a web-specific cap only if natural runs consistently exceed the intended short-session target.

standardRoster.philosophy: Reward quickly without importing the mobile economy.
standardRoster.classic: Unlock after the player's first completed Standard run.
standardRoster.gully: Unlock at 600 Standard best score OR after 3 completed Standard runs, whichever happens first.

modeAvailability.fmf: Available as a distinct web-preview experience once the final cartridge is qualified.
modeAvailability.zen: Available as a distinct web-preview experience once the final cartridge is qualified.

unlockDesign.note: 5 Minute Feast canonically forces Chomper. Zen canonically forces Princess Lily. Gully remains runtime id 'pelican'.

persistence.stageA: session-only is acceptable for technical qualification
persistence.finalPreview: host-owned local persistence required for Standard best-score/unlock progression
persistence.bridgeRule: Opaque-origin cartridge receives only explicit preview state through toadal.game.v1. Do not add allow-same-origin merely for save access.

priorityOrder: character unlock or unlock progress where applicable

identity.headline: TOADAL FEAST Arcade Preview
identity.conversionMessage: Play a compact Arcade sampler on the web, then continue with the full TOADAL FEAST adventure.

runtimeEntitlementBridge.purpose: Allow the Standard web-preview roster to use canonical Arcade character implementations without changing mobile pricing/unlock rules.
runtimeEntitlementBridge.rule: Host sends the unlocked Standard-preview character IDs. The cartridge adapter may seed equivalent in-memory runtime ownership only for the current preview session before selecting a character.
forbidden: writing preview unlocks into the mobile froggyFeast save
exposing arbitrary parent localStorage to the cartridge

intentionalRuntimeFamilies: Standard Arcade runtime and reachable food/hazard/pickup/power-up assets
Classic Frog assets needed by Standard preview
Gully/pelican assets needed by Standard preview
Chomper runtime assets required by 5 Minute Feast
Princess Lily runtime assets required by Zen
shared Arcade runtime/scripts/styles used by standard/fmf/zen
excludeFamilies: Feast Frenzy/tc presentation and forced-character assets unless shared runtime proves unavoidable
non-preview playable character animation families unless runtime proves unavoidable
shop/cosmetics/daily-goal presentation assets not required by the three preview experiences
raw source/master art not needed at runtime
optimizationOrder: qualify gameplay depth and isolation before trimming
qualify Standard, 5 Minute Feast and Zen in the same final cartridge
capture runtime request/reachability ledger across all three experiences
classify unresolved references rather than treating every token as a missing file

acceptance: Standard Arcade demonstrates meaningful gameplay beyond a 16-second level-1 witness
Toadal core mechanics required by the source authority are directly demonstrated
realistic touch drag plus simultaneous movement/action are witnessed on mobile
Classic Frog and Gully can start and complete real Standard runs through canonical character behavior
5 Minute Feast runs with canonical five-minute rules and forced Chomper
Zen runs with canonical Zen rules and forced Princess Lily
web unlocks do not change canonical mobile coin costs or mobile save data
final-preview Standard best score/unlocks persist through website-owned isolated storage
opaque-origin cartridge cannot access unrelated website/account/session storage
unresolved dependency references are classified before pruning
authoritative mechanics/browser verifiers target the modified final cartridge
pause/restart/exit/fullscreen work through host in all preview experiences
package provenance/hash and exact final runtime ledger are recorded
real cartridge screenshots captured for Standard, 5 Minute Feast and Zen
results presentation rewards play before conversion CTA
Wicked Bites compatibility route and final website regressions/export pass before integration
